thread:
taylor: Heads-up: release pipeline 3333 failed at 'untar-artifacts' on staging. deploybot auto-paused promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for commit ghi789jkl due to step 'untar-artifacts' failure on runner staging-12. Error: unexpected EOF while reading archive. Auto-retries exhausted (3/3).

mina: unexpected EOF usually means partial upload or corrupted stream. Does S3 show complete object size?

taylor: checking: s3://ci-artifacts/releases/ghi789/artifacts.tar.gz size 12,345,678 bytes. Builder expected 12,345,680 bytes. Off by 2 bytes.

devops: that delta smells like a truncated multipart upload. Could be client abort or interrupted network. Any uploader retries? buildkite shows complete exit code 0 but with a final warning about socket close.

mina: given the change window we shouldn't risk promoting. Options: 1) Re-upload artifact from builder cache (if available) and re-run pipeline; 2) Promote last known good (v1.4.8) and open an incident; 3) Force-promote (not recommended).

taylor: builder cache still has artifact at /tmp/buildkite/artifacts/3333/artifacts.tar.gz. I'll validate checksum and re-upload with verified size.

qa-bot: Quick checklist if reupload chosen: run unpack + smoke, run migration dry-run, run auth smoke. Report any flaky tests.

mina: also add a short note to release notes about artifact reupload and integrity check to keep audit clear.

taylor: running verification locally:
```
sha256sum /tmp/buildkite/artifacts/3333/artifacts.tar.gz
size: 12345680
sha256: ffeedd00112233...
```

taylor: uploading canonical copy:
```
aws s3 cp /tmp/buildkite/artifacts/3333/artifacts.tar.gz s3://ci-artifacts/releases/ghi789/artifacts.tar.gz --acl private
aws s3api put-object --bucket ci-artifacts --key releases/ghi789/artifacts.sha256 --body <(echo "ffeedd00112233...  artifacts.tar.gz")
```

deploy-bot: Manual retry requested by taylor for pipeline 3333. Queued on runner staging-14.

devops: good call reusing builder copy. Also kicking infra to check for any S3 multipart abort logs in the last 2h. Pinged infra-oncall.

(6m later)

deploy-bot: Pipeline 3333 retry completed with exit code 0. untar-artifacts PASS. Canaries remain paused pending smoke checks.

qa-bot: smoke run started: migration dry-run ok, auth smoke ok, basic health-checks ok.

mina: once smoke is green, we can proceed with canary promotion. I still want infra to confirm no wider S3/multipart issues. If infra sees anomalies we'll rollback and pin.

taylor: smoke all green. Posting artifacts sha256 and uploader logs to the release ticket for audit.

infra-oncall (devops): checked S3 logs: found one multipart upload abort for object releases/ghi789/artifacts.tar.gz around the time of initial build. Root cause: transient network blip in eu-west-1; no systemic errors. Marking incident INFRA-2320 low-impact.

mina: okay, decision: promote canary now and monitor closely. If we see repeat truncation across runners, pin back to v1.4.8 and open a rollback.

taylor: initiating canary promote in 5m. I'll watch health checks.

(15m later)

qa-bot: canary health stable for 10m. No regressions observed.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion completed. Release continued.

mina: updating release notes: "Recovered from truncated artifact upload: re-uploaded verified artifact, ran smoke tests, canary promoted. Observer: infra found transient multipart abort in eu-west-1 (INFRA-2320)."

taylor: closing thread for this window. Thanks all.
